# Mathmagician

> Mathmagician is a free timed mental math game by Lowkey Tools. Practice addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division in 10-second to 2-minute rounds, then review your speed and share your score.

Canonical page: https://mathmagician.lowkey.tools/

The game is free, frontend-only, and needs JavaScript. Four difficulty modes support five expression challenges and 10, 20, 30, 60, or 120-second rounds. Correct whole-number answers earn one point per expression. Targets are editorial practice estimates, not measured human averages. Records stay in this browser; offline play works after the first successful cache.

## Game and rules
- [Play Mathmagician](https://mathmagician.lowkey.tools/): Canonical interactive game with visible rules, FAQs, and creator credits.
- [Complete game guide](https://mathmagician.lowkey.tools/index.md): Markdown version of the rules, modes, scoring, timing, offline support, and limitations shown on the game page.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://mathmagician.lowkey.tools/#faq): Direct answers about arithmetic, scoring, and installation.

## Makers
- [OwlEye Analytics](https://owleye.dev): Cookie-free web analytics; Mathmagician is from the makers of OwlEye.
- [Shrinath Prabhu](https://shrinath.me): Mathmagician’s builder; frontend engineering, projects, and writing.
- [Follow @shrinath_prabhu on X](https://x.com/shrinath_prabhu): Follow the maker’s updates.
- [Lowkey Tools](https://lowkey.tools): The collection that includes Mathmagician.

## Beyond the scoreboard
- [SuperSplit](https://supersplit.lowkey.tools): Put the mental maths down after dinner. SuperSplit tracks who paid, splits group expenses, and works out who owes whom.

## Reference
- [Arithmetic research](https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0168431): Context for practice-target estimates; it does not measure these game modes or establish a Mathmagician player average.
